card grid and boxed panels, replaced by rule-separated sections and hairline lists
spreadsheet KPI grids and horizontally scrolling tables on the phone, replaced by tinted stat tiles and card rows rebuilt from data-label cells
the login passport ledger of lot codes and sample stats, leaving only the poster wordmark and the form
fixed px type steps on poster and figure roles, replaced by fluid clamp tokens
ISO dates in the UI: every display path renders dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM while storage keeps the ISO stamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

delta: vs the Dose entry below: same palette, faces and passport stamp, different composition - the shell was rebuilt mobile-first (masthead, tab bar, scrim drawer, desktop sidebar from 64rem), the login became a split poster/form, queue rows and tables were reduced to hairline lists with ghost actions; this pass also enforces profile permissions (parceiro cannot reach /cadastro, /estoque, /operador, /indicadores or /pesagem, and sees only its own solicitacoes and lotes), stamps every record with date and hour (a Hora field beside each Data field, stored as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, an existing database migrated on load) and renders it all as dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM in pt-BR, and removes the login passport panel; this last pass rebuilds every dashboard and list as an app layout - stat tiles instead of a bordered grid, tables that become labelled card rows under 48rem with no sideways scroll, queue rows with the action pinned right and a middot meta join, and bar/progress figures moved out of the fill so no value sits on a tint; the accessibility and reach pass that follows wires every field to its label (44 for-associated ids, role=radiogroup, role=alert errors, aria-current on the active route, aria-pressed on the demo pills), gives the shell a skip link, moves focus to main after each route change, lets the drawer close on Esc with the background inert and focus returned to its opener, drops the card-mode thead from the accessibility tree while cells keep data-label, measures all 23 colour pairs at 4.5:1 or better, keeps every interactive target at least 44px on the phone, pins each form's primary action in a sticky bar above the tab bar so the thumb never leaves the hot zone, and drops the Estoque screen's Destinar lotes shortcut whenever no batch has balance left, so a dry stock shows only the empty state
